meta.universe: S&P 500 + S&P 400 (903 tickers, $3+ price, $5M+ avg daily dollar volume)
meta.episode_definition: gain of >= 80% within 63 trading days (~3 months); episodes < 6 months apart merged

backtest.note: Forward stats measured over next 63 trading days from every qualifying ticker-day, 2016-2026. p_max40 = probability the stock trades >= +40% above entry at some point within 63 days. p_dd20 = probability it trades <= -20% below entry within 63 days.

S1_hi_vol_rs.label: New 52w high + volume >1.3x + RS>+10% + golden cross

S3_tight_break.label: Tight quiet base + new 52w high + golden cross

S4_dip_uptrend.label: RSI<35 dip, 10-25% off high, in strong uptrend

S5_ignition.label: IGNITION: +12% in 5 days on 1.5x volume, uptrend

episode_start_profile.note: Median feature values on the day before an episode's optimal entry vs random control days. The optimal entry is usually a LOCAL LOW - it looks weak, not strong. You cannot time the exact bottom; you can catch the ignition that follows.

famous_episodes.note: AI-server order book inflection; +80% in 3 months after years range-bound
HBM/AI memory supercycle ignition at ~$64; ran toward ~$900 by Aug 2026 (~7x+)

ignition_fires.name: Illumina
ignition_fires.why: Fresh ignition (Sep 18): +16% week on 1.7x volume at a new 52-week high. Joins the S&P 500 on Sep 21 (forced index buying). Core sequencing growth re-accelerating; +82% in 6 months with analyst targets still trailing price.

ignition_fires.name: Moderna
ignition_fires.why: Re-ignition (Sep 17) on 3x volume after August's +156% month on positive intismeran (melanoma cancer-vaccine) trial data. Highest-octane name here: +439% YTD but analysts split (one Sell at $81 target vs Wolfe upgrade). Classic post-catalyst continuation setup with violent drawdown risk.

ignition_fires.name: CNH Industrial
ignition_fires.why: Ignition (Sep 8): Evercore + Baird upgrades on a 2027 farm-cycle recovery; post-earnings +23% week. Cheap cyclical turning up from a multi-year base with dealer inventories normalizing - early-cycle profile similar to Dell Dec-2023.

leaders.name: Abercrombie & Fitch
leaders.why: Aug 26 earnings ignition: +35% day (EPS $4.17 vs $2.32 prior year, raised guidance, $100M tariff refund). Still 11% below high after digesting - backtest says continuation odds stay elevated for ~3 months post-ignition.

leaders.name: Skyworks Solutions
leaders.why: +24% five-day rally as the $22B Qorvo merger enters final regulatory phase (year-end close). 36% short interest = squeeze fuel. Sits just under the ignition volume threshold - a close above with volume confirms.

leaders.name: Valero Energy
leaders.why: Refining supercycle: record crack spreads from a global fuel squeeze. VLO/MPC/PSX/DINO all doubled YTD and sit at 52-week highs with RSI ~80 - extended; the play is dips, not chases. Group RS is the strongest in the universe.

leaders.name: Marathon Petroleum
leaders.why: +151% YTD on tight fuel markets; same refining-margin thesis as VLO. At highs on rising volume.

leaders.name: Revvity
leaders.why: Life-science tools group move (ILMN, TMO, A, CRL, AVTR, BIO all score >= 4): sector rotation into a beaten-down group, volume confirming. Group breadth = durable theme signal.

leaders.name: Roivant Sciences
leaders.why: +160% over 12 months, elevated volume, near highs - biotech capital-rotation beneficiary alongside MRNA.

playbook.signal: IGNITION = 5-day return > +12% AND 21-day avg volume > 1.5x its 126-day average AND 50dma > 200dma (price $3+, dollar volume $5M+).
playbook.stats: 27% of ignitions saw another +40% within 63 trading days (5.8x the 4.6% baseline); 8.2% saw +80% (13x baseline). Mean 63-day forward return +17% vs +4.5% baseline. Positive edge in 10 of 11 years.
playbook.risk: 23% of ignitions dipped -20% below entry within the window (vs 12% baseline). Position sizing and staggered entries matter more than precision.
checklist: Did the stock jump >= 12% in a week on >= 1.5x normal volume?
Is the 50-day MA above the 200-day MA (established uptrend or early turn)?
Is there a real catalyst - earnings inflection, new product cycle, index inclusion, M&A, sector supercycle?
Is relative strength vs the market positive and rising?
Enter in tranches; expect a -20% shakeout 1-in-4 times; give it up to 3 months.
